summary: The Bun.WebView driver's `text()` returned any node's `value`, and every `<button>` has one (`""`), so `expect.text` on a button never matched in a real browser: the avatar "Saved" critical journey failed in production while the Solid DOM driver passed. Fixed by reading `value` only from `<input>` / `<textarea>`, else visible text, else `aria-label`, like the Solid DOM driver.
